title: Agent swarm, premium rebuild: ten agent windows fanning out round one comment, nothing fixed
goal:
Krish, 10 Nov, on the first cut of this device: "these animations do not look very premium". Why, as seen: each device floats small in a flat black void, no light or depth, tiny default-looking type, emoji-like glyphs, and most frames stand still (the quota chart had 124 distinct frames in 40 s). The bar is his Friday 23 Oct and Monday 26 Oct cuts (config/reference-cuts.json): every frame designed and owned by the brand, light, depth and material, minimal random components and labels, good motion. For the 16:9 wide cut first (box 1920x1080 minus the face window at bottom right, left 1452 top 676 w 400 h 340), tall second.

Premium stage, for every state:
a. Fill the box: the composition spans at least 80% of the box width; nothing important under the face window.
b. A lit stage, not a void: tokens.inkDeep to tokens.ink radial light from the upper left, a soft floor shadow under each object, a fine film grain (SVG feTurbulence, 3% opacity, re-seeded every 2 frames).
c. A camera: a slow push from 1.00 to 1.06 across the device's life with 2 layers of parallax (background 0.5x), and each state change eased with the house curves (clock.ts), overshoot at most 4%.
d. Always alive: no frame identical to the previous for more than 15 frames while the device is on screen (idle breathing of 1 to 2 px, light drift, a counter tick).
e. Type: numbers and the one headline in Anton at 120 px or more, human words in Fraunces semibold at 56 px or more, Plex Mono only for a source line at 28 px or more. At most two labels on screen at once. No axis zeros, no axis titles.

The story, in states (verbs unchanged): enter, the comment arrives as a large cream chat card at the centre of the frame (Fraunces 64 px, typed on word by word, a hard house shadow, 6 degrees of perspective); add, ten agent windows (small ink terminal cards, a mint status dot, three animated cream lines of abstract code, never readable words) fly in on curved paths and fan out round the card in a shallow 3D arc, each with a soft trail; fill, every window works: lines scroll, dots pulse out of phase, faint coral threads connect each window to the card, and 'AGENTS' over a big Anton counter climbing to params.agents sits to the right; mark, a thick hand-drawn coral strike crosses the card over 10 frames, the windows dim to tokens.inkSoft one by one, and params.annotation sets in Fraunces italic 48 px under the card. Drop the robot glyphs. The rank chip draws only when rank.from differs from rank.to.
contract: Change only the agent_swarm device and its fixture and tests; verbs and params keep their meaning. Colours only from tokens. Keep existing tests passing and add: ten windows each at least 120 px wide on 16:9; no text under 28 px; no readable words inside the agent windows; no two consecutive identical frames for more than 15 frames between enter and exit; the rank chip is absent when rank.from equals rank.to.
acceptance:
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/agent_swarm
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/verbs.test.ts
